run_render_api: create a RenderAPI instance with specified width, height, and GPU device for 3D rendering
load_config: load a House3D configuration from a JSON file to use with the Environment
create_environment: build an Environment object using a RenderAPI, scene ID, and loaded config
test_env_reset: test the Environment reset method to place the agent into the house scene
run_debug_render: run the Environment debug_render method to get a rendered image matrix for display
